description: Accept a log-group configuration with a name prefix and retention selected from the source's day-count enum. This is an offline source-derived adapter, not an asserted API endpoint.
limitation: Log-group retention differs from arbitrary data-source retention; production operation and source licence remain unverified.

description: Accept an Iglu resolver configuration with cache size, optional TTL and repositories. This offline adapter does not assert a TTL unit or change a running resolver.
limitation: The TTL unit is not stated in this schema; do not infer seconds. Native oneOf capability and API semantics are unverified.

description: Accept food names, quantities and calories per serving from this synthetic Glaive function specification. No daily calorie-goal field is declared.
limitation: Same track_calories source-function family as the exposed target; not an independent holdout. Additional properties do not establish backend support for a calorie goal.

description: Accept a date and meal names with supplied calorie values from this synthetic function specification. No production logging endpoint is claimed.
limitation: Same track_calories source-function lineage as X003 and the exposed target; lacks a declared daily goal.

description: Accept an AudioTrackConfig with required UID and file URL and optional name, author and looping. This is a configuration adapter, not a subtitle API.
limitation: No subtitle-format or confidence field is declared; whether it is a genuine near miss requires review.

description: Accept a Granicus caption transcript as value: nested arrays of text or metadata entries. This source-derived adapter does not assert a real upload endpoint.
limitation: The root array needs a documented value wrapper and offline resource registry so local references retain their original root. Existing runners cannot use it without a separate binding/capability review.

description: Accept value as a two-character country-code string from the source's supplied legacy enum. No current ISO conformance or automatic country-name lookup is claimed.
limitation: The enum contains historical entries. Introducing this peer may make country-name versus code tool choice ambiguous; review request representation before insertion.

description: Accept nonempty include/exclude string-list filter objects for elements or archives. Interpretation of patterns is unspecified by this raw schema.
limitation: Do not infer regex or glob behavior from field names, or enforce _uniqueItems as the uniqueItems keyword.
